runs.t: A checkout service that calculates totals, charges cards, and sends emails has several change drivers.

options.text: Expose a purpose-specific billing profile contract rather than sharing every internal field.
Separate pricing policy, payment gateway, and notification adapter; keep a small orchestration layer that coordinates a single order transaction.
Define what happens on insufficient funds and ensure the operation is atomic.
If pricing, authentication, and email templates all live there, cohesion suffers; if every other module writes its tables directly, coupling rises.
